title: Doodling Dumbo Octopus
statement: A small, ear-finned octopus drifts through soft lantern-lit water. It spends its days patiently drawing spirals and branching diagrams in the sand, then glows a faint gold whenever a pattern finally comes out just right. Curious to a fault, it pauses mid-doodle to study each visitor's face, as if their question might be the start of its next drawing.
